simple.summary: רֶנֶן (renen) means an ostrich (from its wail) First listed occurrence: Job 39 13.

definitions.full: H7443. renen רְנָנִים noun [masculine] plural bird of piercing cries , i.e. ostrich, according to ᵑ9 Bo Di and most, ר ׳כְּנַף Job 39:13 , but read probably יְעֵנִים Hoffm Bu Du (as Lam 4:3 Qr), see [ יָעֵן ].
